 Print The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the admit card for the MP Police Subedar (Stenographer) and Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) recruitment test 2026. Candidates who have registered for the recruitment examination can now download their hall tickets from the official website, esb.mp.gov.in. The written examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 21 and 22, 2026. Candidates must download their admit cards and verify the details mentioned on them before appearing for the examination. The recruitment drive aims to fill 655 vacancies across the Subedar (Stenographer) and Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) posts under Advertisement No. 40-A. The application process for the recruitment examination was conducted between September 24 and October 8, 2026. With the examination approaching, candidates are advised to complete the hall ticket download process well in advance to avoid last-minute technical difficulties. Join conversation

 MP Police ASI, Subedar Steno admit card 2026: Login credentials required
 Candidates must keep their application details ready before accessing the admit card download portal. The MPESB requires applicants to enter specific credentials to retrieve their hall tickets. The login details required include: 13-digit application number.
 Date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
 First two letters of the mother's name.
 Last four digits of the Aadhaar number.
 CAPTCHA code, wherever displayed.
 Candidates should ensure that the information entered matches their application records. Incorrect login details may prevent access to the admit card.
 MP Police Subedar Steno, ASI admit card 2026: Steps to download hall tickets 
 Candidates appearing for the November 21 and 22 examination can follow the steps given below to download their hall tickets: Visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board at esb.mp.gov.in.
 Navigate to the admit card or recruitment test section available on the homepage.
 Click on the link titled Subedar (Stenographer) and Assistant Sub-Inspector Recruitment Test 2026.
 Enter the 13-digit application number in the designated field.
 Provide the date of birth in the prescribed format.
 Enter the first two letters of the mother's name along with the last four digits of the Aadhaar number.
 Complete the CAPTCHA verification, if required.
 Click on the submit button to access the admit card.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket and download the PDF.
 Take a clear printout for use on the examination day.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the MP Police Subedar, Steno, ASI admit card 2026. MP Police ASI, Subedar Steno hall ticket: Details to check
 After downloading the admit card, candidates must carefully examine the information printed on it. Any discrepancy in the personal or examination-related details should be brought to the attention of the examination authorities at the earliest. The hall ticket should be checked for the following information: Candidate's name and photograph.
 Roll number and application number.
 Examination date and reporting time.
 Examination centre and complete address.
 Post applied for.
 Examination-related instructions.
 Candidate's signature and other identification details.
 Candidates should pay particular attention to the examination centre address and reporting time to avoid confusion on the day of the test.
